title: Tanzelwil Culanda Stone
flavorText: The bright golden light of this crystal has illuminated the honored tombs at Tanzelwil for generations.
name: Tanzelwil Culanda Stone

title: Veiled Crystal
flavorText: Though the sealing magic this crystal once held is broken, it still emits a soft light.
name: Veiled Crystal

title: Mehrunes Dagon Brazier
flavorText: This brazier once held a Sigil Stone capable of maintaining a gate to the Deadlands.
name: Mehrunes Dagon Brazier

title: High Elf Throne
flavorText: Queen Ayrenn favors a simple, elegant throne of marble and gold, a style that has become popular among her supporters.
name: High Elf Throne

title: Ancient High Elf Statue
flavorText: The High Elves maintain these statues represent their honored ancestors, though some scholars insist they're of Ayleid design.
name: Ancient High Elf Statue

title: Ayleid Throne
flavorText: Based on a design favored by Laloriaran Dynar, last king of the Ayleids.
name: Ayleid Throne

title: Shackle Control Stone
flavorText: Crafted from ebony-alloy cold-iron in Coldharbour's Black Forge.
name: Shackle Control Stone

title: Coldharbour Chandelier
flavorText: The cold blue light from this pillar of crystal has illuminated cruelties beyond measure.
name: Coldharbour Chandelier

title: Cowering Statue
flavorText: An effigy representing all those who recoil in fear before the cruel domination of Molag Bal.
name: Cowering Statue

title: Light of Meridia
flavorText: A shining remembrance of the broad spectrum of heroes who fight for Meridia.
name: Light of Meridia

title: Molag Bal Banner
flavorText: A banner brought back in triumph from the heroic challenges of Coldharbour.
name: Molag Bal Banner

title: Aulus's Captive Audience
flavorText: It's comforting to know that at least one person will stick around until the end of your speech.
name: Aulus's Captive Audience

title: Ukaezai's Ward
flavorText: With any luck, this petrified Ayleid never even felt the loss of his arm.  Or his head.
name: Ukaezai's Ward

title: Guardian Mane
flavorText: Normally found protecting holy sites of the Khajiit, this guardian statue was excavated from the Falinesti Winter Site—lending new credence to the legends of Rajhin's activity in the area.
name: Guardian Mane

title: Orrery Control Pillar Replica
flavorText: Daraneth crafted several such replicas as part of her studies on the Osseous Orrery.
name: Orrery Control Pillar Replica

title: Valenwood Brazier
flavorText: An eternal fire commemorating heroic achievements on the behalf of the citizens of Grahtwood.
name: Valenwood Brazier

title: Fires of the Wilderking
flavorText: The ancient legend of the Wilderking turned out to be the living truth of modern Greenshade.
name: Fires of the Wilderking

title: Sea Elf Banner
flavorText: A banner originally taken as a trophy, following the defeat of the invading Maormer at Seaside Sanctuary.
name: Sea Elf Banner

title: Hectahame Arboretum Relic
flavorText: This human skull emits a peculiar light, reminiscent of the night sky.
name: Hectahame Arboretum Relic

title: Wood Elf Path Marker
flavorText: The Wood Elves could find their way through Valenwood blindfolded—these markers are instead for their guests, who may not find the forests so welcoming.
name: Wood Elf Path Marker

title: Wood Orc Dream Catcher
flavorText: It's well documented that Wood Orc shamans collect dreams, but what they do with them is a closely guarded secret.
name: Wood Orc Dream Catcher

title: Wood Orc Malacath Banner
flavorText: Like their cousins in northern Tamriel, most Wood Orcs honor Malacath.
name: Wood Orc Malacath Banner

title: Wood Elf Union Trellis
flavorText: One tree may bend or break in the storm, but two together can support each other through any weather.
name: Wood Elf Union Trellis

title: Handfast Pedestal
flavorText: An altar for solemnizing the sacred marriage vows of the Wood Elves.
name: Handfast Pedestal

title: Handfast
flavorText: A memorial for the heroic resolution of the Bosmeri existential crisis in Malabal Tor.
name: Handfast

title: Colovian Projection Crystal
flavorText: This crystal emits a gentle violet glow, even while separated from the rest of the projection apparatus.
name: Colovian Projection Crystal

title: Moonmont Lunar Altar
flavorText: Attuned to the light of the two moons, this shrine can be refocused to several different lunar phases.
name: Moonmont Lunar Altar

title: Khajiiti Shrine Guardian Statue
flavorText: These stylized senche-cats can be found watching over shrines throughout Reaper's March.
name: Khajiiti Shrine Guardian Statue

title: Waxing Moons Wall Tile
flavorText: Depicts Jone and Jode, both in the waxing phase.
name: Waxing Moons Wall Tile

title: Waning Moons Tile
flavorText: Depicts Jone and Jode, both in the waning phase.
name: Waning Moons Tile

title: Full Moons Tile
flavorText: Depicts Jone and Jode, both full and bright.
name: Full Moons Tile

title: New Moons Tile
flavorText: Depicts Jone and Jode, both new and dark.
name: New Moons Tile

title: Wyrdstone
flavorText: Marks an area that is under the protection of the Beldama Wyrd.
name: Wyrdstone

title: Torn Lion Guard Banner
flavorText: The Lion Guard are at their strongest with their backs against a wall.
name: Torn Lion Guard Banner

title: Breton Gravewatcher Statue
flavorText: These enormous statues were originally commisioned to watch over the dead in Cath Bedraud.
name: Breton Gravewatcher Statue

title: Bloodthorn Vines, Small
flavorText: These vines show no sign of further growth, but their gentle movement still disquiets.
name: Bloodthorn Vines, Small

title: Hagraven Totem
flavorText: Folk legends claim that if you camp in the Hag Fens, you will awaken to find yourself rooted in place, your body slowly twisting into the form of a withered tree.
name: Hagraven Totem

title: Knights of the Flame Banner
flavorText: A banner representing the noble knightly order of Alcaire in High Rock.
name: Knights of the Flame Banner

title: Spirit Warden Azura Statue
flavorText: A replica of the celebrated statue of Azura in Pariah Abbey.
name: Spirit Warden Azura Statue

title: Wayrest Guillotine
flavorText: Nightmares about guillotines are remarkably common in Wayrest.
name: Wayrest Guillotine

title: Replica Dreamshard
flavorText: Witnesses confirm that this replica is faithful to the original appearance of the mystical object.
name: Replica Dreamshard

title: Vaermina Statue
flavorText: Originally commisioned by a noble to give a face to the nightmares that plagued him night after a night. It didn't help.
name: Vaermina Statue

title: Constellation Tile: The Ritual
flavorText: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Ritual.
name: Constellation Tile: The Ritual

title: Constellation Tile: The Shadow
flavorText: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Shadow.
name: Constellation Tile: The Shadow

title: Constellation Tile: The Tower
flavorText: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Tower.
name: Constellation Tile: The Tower

title: Wagon of Death
flavorText: You're going to give these people an honest burial, right?
name: Wagon of Death

title: Tamrith Coffin Lid
flavorText: It's said that the dead rise so often in Rivenspire that they put the handles on the insides of the coffin lids.
name: Tamrith Coffin Lid

title: Tamrith Coffin
flavorText: Make your bedroom a dead-room with a coffin from haunted Rivenspire.
name: Tamrith Coffin

title: Gargoyle Statue
flavorText: Originally found in the vampire-infested ruins of Shadowfate Cavern, it has shown no sign of animating. Yet.
name: Gargoyle Statue

title: Tu'whacca's Brazier
flavorText: Used in the worship of Tu'whacca, who guides the fallen to the Far Shores.
name: Tu'whacca's Brazier

title: Reconstructed Necromantic Focus
flavorText: This has an unsettling habit of spontaneously reconstructing itself when destroyed.
name: Reconstructed Necromantic Focus

title: Standing Ansei Statue
flavorText: The triumph of the Ansei will never be forgotten.
name: Standing Ansei Statue

title: Kneeling Ansei Statue
flavorText: The sacrifice of the Ansei will never be forgotten.
name: Kneeling Ansei Statue

title: Replica of Shattered Ansei Sword
flavorText: The remains of one of several decoys commisioned by King Fahara'jad.
name: Replica of Shattered Ansei Sword

title: Glenmoril Wyrd Stone
flavorText: The prevailing theory is that the red pigment on these stones is derived from a rare crimson flower, and is not the "blood of trespassing children," as claimed by some in Evermore.
name: Glenmoril Wyrd Stone

title: Damaged Knight of St. Pelin Statue
flavorText: Damaged in Septima Tharn's assault on Bangkorai Garrison.
name: Damaged Knight of St. Pelin Statue

title: Evermore Mourning Banner
flavorText: In Evermore, those who have lost a loved one display their mourning banner on a spear, to represent the wound in their heart.
name: Evermore Mourning Banner

title: Ragged Imperial Banner
flavorText: One of the few relatively intact banners recovered following the Imperial occupation of Southern Bangkorai.
name: Ragged Imperial Banner

title: Ceremonial Redguard Vessel
flavorText: This massive bowl is traditionally used as a brazier for rites honoring the fallen.
name: Ceremonial Redguard Vessel

title: Serien's Stand
flavorText: A remembrance of the last stand of the obstreperous General Serien.
name: Serien's Stand

title: Lacquered Kwama Egg
flavorText: An exquisite painted trophy memorializing heroic triumphs in Stonefalls.
name: Lacquered Kwama Egg

title: Daedric Sconce
flavorText: An ominous light source pillaged from Oblivion.
name: Daedric Sconce

title: Blood Fountain
flavorText: A grim reminder that the victories in Stonefalls were not without a price.
name: Blood Fountain

title: Remnant of Balreth
flavorText: A hunk of bone and char, left over from the defeat of Balreth.
name: Remnant of Balreth

title: Mimic Hist Tree
flavorText: A convincing replica of one of the mystically-sentient trees revered by the Argonians.
name: Mimic Hist Tree

title: Argonian Egg
flavorText: A replica of an egg of the reptilian Argonians of Shadowfen.
name: Argonian Egg

title: Replica Mnemic Egg
flavorText: Following attempts by the Aldmeri Dominion to capture the Mnemic Egg, several replicas were created to foil future attempts.
name: Replica Mnemic Egg

title: Replica Stone Nest
flavorText: Traditionally, the dais that holds Mnemic Egg is referred to as its nest.
name: Replica Stone Nest

title: Oblivion Stone
flavorText: A dark chunk of raw stone, branded with the Daedric sigil Khot.
name: Oblivion Stone

title: Lob's Challenge Horn
flavorText: Winding this horn in Giant country could have hazardous results.
name: Lob's Challenge Horn

title: Standing Slab
flavorText: This menhir of the ancient Nords stands in solemn tribute to the hero of Eastmarch.
name: Standing Slab

title: Dragon Shrine Altar
flavorText: Long ago the ancient Nords worshiped living Dragons at altars like this one.
name: Dragon Shrine Altar

title: Throne of the Skald-King
flavorText: A replica of the throne of High King Jorunn granted in gratitude for services to Eastmarch.
name: Throne of the Skald-King

title: Visage of the Skald
flavorText: A traditional trophy of high-ranking bards of Skyrim.
name: Visage of the Skald

title: Swamp Anemone
flavorText: A living trophy and constant reminder of the lush fungal foliage of Deshaan.
name: Swamp Anemone

title: Veloth's Reliquary
flavorText: Relish this replica reliquary for retaining relics of the revered Veloth.
name: Veloth's Reliquary

title: Tribunal Rug
flavorText: A circular rug, emblazoned with the bronze symbol of the Tribunal.
name: Tribunal Rug

title: Tribunal Altar
flavorText: Each side of this pillar represents one of the three members of the Tribunal: Almalexia, Sotha Sil, and Vivec.
name: Tribunal Altar

title: Touch of Plague
flavorText: A sealed container, believed to hold a sample of the Llodos plague.
name: Touch of Plague

title: Ancient Cultist Totem
flavorText: Legend claims that the skulls beneath Fallowstone Vault hark back to the age of the Dragon Cult.
name: Ancient Cultist Totem

title: Ysgramor Statue
flavorText: A statue honoring the Nord culture hero Ysgramor, "The Harbinger of us all."
name: Ysgramor Statue

title: Statue of the Wolf
flavorText: A recreation of the statue that has sat outside Fallowstone Hall for longer than anyone can remember.
name: Statue of the Wolf

title: Totem of the Reach
flavorText: This totem doesn't seem to carry the usual death curse. No one's died yet, at least.
name: Totem of the Reach

title: Torn Worm Cult Banner
flavorText: One of many trophies taken following the defeat of the Worm Cult in The Rift.
name: Torn Worm Cult Banner

title: Serpent Stone
flavorText: A Craglorn-style trophy awarded to commemorate victory in the Dragonstar Arena.
name: Serpent Stone

title: Nirncrux Bowl
flavorText: The rare material Nirncrux is so prized by the miners of Craglorn that it is conveyed in special bowls.
name: Nirncrux Bowl

title: Snake Prayer Tile
flavorText: A holy symbol of the ancient Nedes denoting a location of worship.
name: Snake Prayer Tile

title: Totem of the Serpent
flavorText: A memorial commemorating the defeat of the Serpent Constellation's machinations in Craglorn.
name: Totem of the Serpent

title: Craglorn Tapestry
flavorText: A reconstruction of the famous tapestry depicting the conflict of the Constellations.
name: Craglorn Tapestry

title: Craglorn Brazier
flavorText: A brazier originally used by one of the ancient and nigh-forgotten cultures of Craglorn.
name: Craglorn Brazier

title: Craglorn Sconce
flavorText: A light source crafted in the style of the ancient Ra Gada conquerors of Craglorn.
name: Craglorn Sconce

title: Observatory Banner
flavorText: This long banner depicts a stylized and ordered version of the sky, as observed by the Stargazers of Craglorn.
name: Observatory Banner

title: Poisoned Blood
flavorText: This is a small house item.
name: Poisoned Blood

title: Gold Coast Estate Keg
flavorText: A keg of Anvil malmsey to mark the expert infiltration skills of a Dark Brotherhood initiate.
name: Gold Coast Estate Keg

title: Light and Shadow
flavorText: This is a small house item.
name: Light and Shadow

title: Hourglass Rug
flavorText: A rug stolen from those officious knights of the Order of the Hour.
name: Hourglass Rug

title: Sanctuary Sconce
flavorText: This light source is a reminder of the tasteful and restrained décor of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
name: Sanctuary Sconce

title: Brotherhood Poison Vial
flavorText: An ornamental copy of one of the Dark Brotherhood's bottled toxins.
name: Brotherhood Poison Vial

title: Order of the Hour Banner
flavorText: A banner "borrowed" from the Akatosh-worshiping knights of the Order of the Hour.
name: Order of the Hour Banner

title: Dark Brotherhood Banner
flavorText: This hanging banner announces one's membership in the Dark Brotherhood. Display it with caution.
name: Dark Brotherhood Banner

title: Banner of the Kvatch Guard
flavorText: The noble wolf's-head banner of the respected Kvatch Guard.
name: Banner of the Kvatch Guard

title: Statue of the Mother
flavorText: No one would be so bold as to assert without contradiction that this is a statue representing the Night Mother.
name: Statue of the Mother

title: Preserved Sweetrolls
flavorText: A cluster of sweetrolls—a delicious trophy that commemorates thwarting the Sweetroll Killer of the Gold Coast.
name: Preserved Sweetrolls

title: Litany of Blood
flavorText: A replica of the Dark Brotherhood's sinister tome of death.
name: Litany of Blood

title: Sacrificial Heart
flavorText: This is a small house item.
name: Sacrificial Heart

title: Dark Ledger
flavorText: Every Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary has a book that balances the costs of living against the wages of death.
name: Dark Ledger

title: Reliquary Skull
flavorText: A replica of the Giovessen Skull, a relic whose history extends back nearly 600 years.
name: Reliquary Skull

title: Pale Garden Flowers
flavorText: These flowers are a reminder of how short and ephemeral a thief's life can be.
name: Pale Garden Flowers

title: Jar of Green Dye
flavorText: Enough concentrated green dye to make Hammerfell look like Valenwood.
name: Jar of Green Dye

title: An Adoring Fan
flavorText: A souvenir of your visit to an exclusive Hew's Bane soiree.
name: An Adoring Fan

title: Yokudan Puzzle Column
flavorText: Puzzle locks based on rotating stone pillars have been used in vaults and labyrinths since time immemorial. This version hails from ancient Yokuda.
name: Yokudan Puzzle Column

title: Abah's Landing Banner
flavorText: The flag of the Free and Open Trading Port of Abah's Landing.
name: Abah's Landing Banner

title: Iron Wheel Banner
flavorText: The banner of those over-achieving law enforcers known as the Iron Wheel.
name: Iron Wheel Banner

title: Vibrant Garden Flowers
flavorText: The life of a desert flower is brief but bright, so the Redguards treasure them for their gardens.
name: Vibrant Garden Flowers

title: Distracting Harpy Egg
flavorText: "The hideous harpy, half-avian abomination, is shunned by all the faithful of Tava." —The Revered Mubdaraz
name: Distracting Harpy Egg

title: Banner of Taneth
flavorText: The esteemed banner of the Kingdom of Taneth in Hammerfell.
name: Banner of Taneth

title: Redguard Round Table
flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Redguard Round Table

title: Statue of Shadows
flavorText: Though all are impressed by the grave solemnity of this statue, none can agree on whom it represents.
name: Statue of Shadows

title: Hiding Place
flavorText: A typical nondescript Abah's Landing basket. No one would ever think of looking in there!
name: Hiding Place

title: Orsinium Cart
flavorText: An Orcish wheeled cart: they build 'em sturdy in Wrothgar.
name: Orsinium Cart

title: Orc Adventuring Backpack
flavorText: This rugged and capacious backpack is a reminder not to venture unequipped into the wilds of Wrothgar.
name: Orc Adventuring Backpack

title: Orcish War Totem
flavorText: Orcs like to announce great events by erecting symbolic totems: this one heralds war.
name: Orcish War Totem

title: Orcish Battle Totem
flavorText: Orcs like to announce great events by erecting symbolic totems: this one foretells battle.
name: Orcish Battle Totem

title: Fur Throne
flavorText: If you were an Orc chieftain in frozen Wrothgar, you'd want furs on your throne, too.
name: Fur Throne

title: Orcish Totem
flavorText: Orcs like to announce events by erecting symbolic totems: this one marks territory.
name: Orcish Totem

title: Throne of the Orc King
flavorText: A replica of the throne entitled by tradition to the Orc chief who unites the clans into a kingdom.
name: Throne of the Orc King

title: Molag Bal Brazier
flavorText: This Coldharbour brazier commemorates the thwarting of Molag Bal's last-ditch attack on Nirn.
name: Molag Bal Brazier

title: Imperial Banner
flavorText: A banner earned for plumbing the labyrinth of sewers beneath the Imperical City.
name: Imperial Banner

title: Pirate Banner
flavorText: Proudly fly the flag of Abecean piracy after recruiting freebooters for a daring venture.
name: Pirate Banner

title: Maormer Totem
flavorText: A symbol of the perfidious Sea Elves of Pyandonea.
name: Maormer Totem

title: Coldharbour Urn
flavorText: Replica of an urn as found in the Wailing Prison in Coldharbour. Because you always remember your first iron dagger.
name: Coldharbour Urn

title: Replica Soul Gem
flavorText: A copy of one of the mysterious and mystical crystals used to capture the souls of dying entities.
name: Replica Soul Gem

title: Replica Black Soul Gem
flavorText: An imitation of one of those sinister crystals used to entrap the souls of dying sentient beings.
name: Replica Black Soul Gem

title: Soul Gem Case
flavorText: The sort of case sorcerers and necromancers use to keep their soul gems safe, clean, and shiny.
name: Soul Gem Case

title: Spare Flesh Atronach Parts
flavorText: Unlike most summoned Daedra, the Flesh Atronach requires some pre-assembly.
name: Spare Flesh Atronach Parts

title: Soul Gem Crate
flavorText: The sort of crate sorcerers and necromancers use to keep their soul gems safe, clean, and shiny.
name: Soul Gem Crate

title: Lantern of Anguish
flavorText: The crimson light from this lantern complements either torture or seduction equally well.
name: Lantern of Anguish

title: Depleted Sigil Stone
flavorText: A mystic runestone, now drained, once used to hold open an Oblivion gate.
name: Depleted Sigil Stone

title: Silent Sentinel
flavorText: A solemn reminder of the heroic effort to challenge the schemes of Molag Bal.
name: Silent Sentinel

title: Soul Gem Stand
flavorText: Just the thing for displaying your cruel magical implement used to enslave creatures' souls.
name: Soul Gem Stand

title: The Final Threat
flavorText: Molag Bal has had countless such statues erected in his name, and woe unto he who mocks their craftsmanship or artistry.
name: The Final Threat

title: Daedric Chest
flavorText: The heroism of dauntless slayers of Daedra is marked by presentation of a chest stolen from Oblivion.
name: Daedric Chest

title: Broken Chain
flavorText: Links from the fallen chain of a shattered Dark Anchor.
name: Broken Chain

title: Decorative Treasure Chest
flavorText: Someone so relentlessly dedicated to the pursuit of treasure deserves such an ornamental coffer.
name: Decorative Treasure Chest

title: Dueling Banner
flavorText: A banner representing a challenge to the death. Only a supremely confident duelist would decorate their home with such a thing.
name: Dueling Banner

title: Cheese Cutter
flavorText: When the Mages Guild won away Eveyea from Sheogorath, the Madgod presented them with a supply of cheese cutters to award as guild prizes.
name: Cheese Cutter

title: Soul Gem, Common
flavorText: This is a small house item.
name: Soul Gem, Common

title: Soul Gem, Lesser
flavorText: This is a small house item.
name: Soul Gem, Lesser

title: Mages Guild Banner
flavorText: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display Mages Guild affiliation.
name: Mages Guild Banner

title: Fighters Guild Banner
flavorText: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display Fighters Guild affiliation.
name: Fighters Guild Banner

title: Outlaw Banner
flavorText: A banner proudly displaying the covert three-bladed symbol of Tamriel's outlaws. (Wait, that's supposed to be secret!)
name: Outlaw Banner

title: Pile of Coins
flavorText: This replica treasure looks just like a real pile of coins, doesn't it?
name: Pile of Coins

title: Mountain of Loot
flavorText: Never lack for a packed stack of black market fake drakes.
name: Mountain of Loot

title: Mass Tombstone
flavorText: A grim memorial to the staggering number of creatures you've massacred in cold blood.
name: Mass Tombstone

title: Death Marker
flavorText: Yeah, well, they probably had it coming.
name: Death Marker

title: Noble Pocket Lint
flavorText: You've picked so many pockets, the ends of your fingers are chapped.
name: Noble Pocket Lint

title: Pocket Change
flavorText: So now you're a creeping, furtive sneak thief. Wouldn't your parents be so proud?
name: Pocket Change

title: Replica Key Blank
flavorText: Copy of an item perfect for creating illicit copies of a "borrowed" key, or for fashioning into a bump key.
name: Replica Key Blank

title: Decorative Thieves Trove
flavorText: Every time you looted one of these, you thought, "I wish I had one." And now you do.
name: Decorative Thieves Trove

title: Decorative Safebox
flavorText: In the vicinity of such a master cracksman, it's possible that "safebox" is a bit of a misnomer.
name: Decorative Safebox

title: Undaunted Mug
flavorText: A ceremonial mug presented in the name of true Undaunted camaraderie!
name: Undaunted Mug

title: Undaunted Chest
flavorText: A handsome chest for all the loot collected on missions performed for the Undaunted.
name: Undaunted Chest

title: Undaunted Banner
flavorText: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display affiliation with the Undaunted.
name: Undaunted Banner

title: Decorative Skyshard
flavorText: This mystic crystal commemorates the colossal achievement of finding skyshards all across Tamriel.
name: Decorative Skyshard

title: Throne of Cyrodiil
flavorText: Even in the tumult of the Three Banners War, sitting atop the Ruby Throne is a rare and coveted privilege.
name: Throne of Cyrodiil

title: Primal Altar to Hircine
flavorText: Display your feral devotion to the Father of Manbeasts with this rustic altar.
name: Primal Altar to Hircine

title: Crimson-Stained Bowl
flavorText: Baron Montclair preferred to drink from a shallow bowl, claiming that it enhanced bouquet, while allowing just enough coagulation to give a pleasing texture on the tongue.
name: Crimson-Stained Bowl

title: Fishing Vessel
flavorText: Though a master fisher needs only bait and line, most own a small and steady sailboat for lazy Sundas excursions.
name: Fishing Vessel

title: Alchemist's Sign
flavorText: A sign with the symbol used by all those who can tell an alembic from a calcinator.
name: Alchemist's Sign

title: Poison Satchel
flavorText: Poison-making is a skill abhorrent to most citizens of Tamriel, so keep this distinctive satchel a secret.
name: Poison Satchel

title: Blacksmith's Sign
flavorText: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the forge and hammer.
name: Blacksmith's Sign

title: Clothier's Sign
flavorText: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the needle and scissors.
name: Clothier's Sign

title: Enchanter's Sign
flavorText: A sign earned by one who's become a master of Aspect, Essence, and Potency.
name: Enchanter's Sign

title: Enchanting Gem
flavorText: A handsome gem awarded to all those who become Potentates of Potency!
name: Enchanting Gem

title: Provisioner's Sign
flavorText: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the cooking fire and spoons.
name: Provisioner's Sign

title: Chef's Cleaver
flavorText: This is bound to be a useful utensil to one who knows such a quantity of recipes.
name: Chef's Cleaver

title: Woodworker's Sign
flavorText: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the chisel and saw.
name: Woodworker's Sign

title: Hanging Map of Tamriel
flavorText: A well-worn map, clearly used on many a Tamrielic journey.
name: Hanging Map of Tamriel

title: Harvester's Woodpile
flavorText: A symbolic pile of precious woods awarded to a master harvester of timber.
name: Harvester's Woodpile

title: Harvester's Herbs
flavorText: A symbolic bunch of precious plants awarded to a master harvester of herbs.
name: Harvester's Herbs

title: Harvester's Ore
flavorText: A symbolic outcropping of precious raw metal awarded to a master harvester of ore.
name: Harvester's Ore

title: Harvester's Critter Trap
flavorText: A symbolic critter trap awarded to a master harvester of lesser creatures.
name: Harvester's Critter Trap

title: Harvester's Garden Shrub
flavorText: A symbolic flowering shrub awarded to a master harvester of floral materials.
name: Harvester's Garden Shrub

title: Smith's Bellows
flavorText: A smith who's forged as much as you could probably work a smith's hammer with closed eyes. (But don't try it.)
name: Smith's Bellows

title: Dominion Hero Shield
flavorText: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Aldmeri Dominion.
name: Dominion Hero Shield

title: Covenant Hero Shield
flavorText: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant.
name: Covenant Hero Shield

title: Pact Hero Shield
flavorText: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Ebonheart Pact.
name: Pact Hero Shield

title: Display Craft Bag
flavorText: Unlike a real Craft Bag, this display version can't hold impossible amounts of crafting materials.
name: Display Craft Bag

title: Decoy Elder Scroll
flavorText: At exceptional cost, a small number of decoy Elder Scroll cases were commisioned early in the Three Banners War. The enchantments can be adjusted to mimic either an offensive or defensive scroll.
name: Decoy Elder Scroll

title: Aetherial Ambrosia
abilityDescription: You gain a |cffffff100|r% Experience Point bonus from all sources for |cffffff30|r minutes. The timer pauses when you are offline, and resumes when you return. This bonus is compatible with other foods or drinks.
name: Aetherial Ambrosia

title: Diminished Aetherial Dust
flavorText: Though Aetherial Dust can be used to open a person's eyes to untold experiences, its powers weaken over time. However, this Diminished Aetherial Dust still can be employed to craft standard Aetherial Ambrosia.
name: Diminished Aetherial Dust

title: Disconnected Transitus Shrine
flavorText: Though no longer connected to the Transitus Shrine Network, this shrine still emanates power.
name: Disconnected Transitus Shrine

title: The Code of Mauloch
flavorText: Reprint volume from the "Glenumbra Lore" book collection. Mages Guild Edition, 2E 582.
name: The Code of Mauloch

flavorText: Reprint volume from the "Glenumbra Lore" book collection. Mages Guild Edition, 2E 582.
